description: Authoritative update-source registry for Dragonwilds Sync managed runtimes, tooling and RSDW content. Logical runtime components and data sources are kept distinct even where a legacy physical directory name remains for compatibility.

rsdwtools.description: Canonical GitHub-backed data/content source for icons, item manifests and reference data. It is not the installed UE4SS Toolkit runtime.

rsdw-icons.description: Canonical colored RSDW icon pack. Dragonwilds Sync maintains its own validated icon fingerprint/index so exact item-to-icon associations survive offline use.

rsdw-item-manifest.description: Canonical RSDW item JSON tree and item-editor association data used to build Dragonwilds Sync's offline manifest/index.

rsdw-toolkit.description: Server/host-only UE4SS runtime tooling for spawning, live map hooks, console commands and game-runtime integration. It is updated from RSDWArchive/RSDWDevKit and is never sent to joining clients.

dragonconnect.description: Hidden modular UE4SS application bridge with independent Items, server Chat, and one-shot client Connect DLLs.

runeschema.description: Official RuneSchema release source. Dragonwilds Sync resolves downloadable ZIP assets through GitHub's release API, validates them, installs through an explicit client/server layout, and retains the bundled package only as an offline/recovery fallback. RuneSchema child content remains a first-class logical mod family.

ue4ss.description: Official UE4SS release source. Dragonwilds Sync resolves the tagged release ZIP through GitHub's API and installs it through role-specific validation. Upstream version.dll files are ignored; Dragonwilds' separate server loader is preserved only beside the dedicated server dwmapi.dll.

rsdwmodel.description: Avatar/model source used by the RSDW Toolkit character experience.
